name: The Shade of Elura
summary: At Auberdine, Elura's shade guards a sunken ship and its Elunite ore. Elanaria sends young night elf warriors into the waters to lay the captain to rest and recover her medallion and ore for a weapon forged by Smith Mathiel.

sections.title: A Captain's Eternal Guard
sections.body: Long ago, a ship carrying rare Elunite ore struck jagged coastal rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse and sank. The captain, Elura, cursed her own soul in despair and out of unwavering duty. Bound to the wreck beneath the waves, her shade guards the lost cargo from anyone who would disturb it.

sections.title: Weapons of Elunite
sections.body: Elanaria sends young night elf warriors into Darkshore's surf to defeat Elura, recover her medallion, and salvage the ore. They need both the medallion and ore to put the captain to rest and bring the metal to Smith Mathiel's forge. The work tests their martial skill and respect for the fallen, and provides the ore for a crafted weapon.

faq.q: Who is the Shade of Elura?
faq.answer: Elura was captain of an elven ship that wrecked on the shallows near the Auberdine lighthouse. She cursed herself to guard the sunken cargo of Elunite ore.

faq.q: Why does Elanaria send warriors after Elura?
faq.answer: Elanaria sends warriors to defeat Elura, recover her medallion and ore, and put her spirit to rest. The trial tests their prowess and provides the material for a weapon.
The wreck lies underwater off Auberdine's coast in Darkshore, near the lighthouse and just south of the main harbor docks.

faq.q: What is Elunite ore used for?
faq.answer: Night elven smiths use rare Elunite ore to forge weapons. The salvaged crates go to Smith Mathiel in Darnassus, who makes a personalized martial weapon for promising warriors.

faq.q: Does defeating the shade harm Elura permanently?
faq.answer: Defeating Elura breaks the curse binding her spirit to the sea floor. Elanaria says that besting the captain in combat brings her peace after her long vigil.

faq.q: Who crafts the weapon once the ore is collected?
faq.answer: After Elanaria receives the ore and medallion, she sends the warrior to Smith Mathiel in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. He works the metal into an exceptional weapon.

angles.text: As a night elf warrior, you prove your aquatic grit and martial discipline in a trial that earns you a forged Elunite weapon.
As a night elf, you honor a fellow kaldorei by laying Elura's shade to rest after her sense of duty bound her beneath the waves for generations.
As a blacksmith, you see the night elves' metallurgical traditions in the potent armaments they craft from blessed Elunite materials.
